title: Public contracts (Portal BASE)

provenance.by: sources/base-gov-pt/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: IMPIC publishes these contracts as open data on dados.gov.pt with the licence "Outra (Domínio Público)" (other-pd, public domain); we name IMPIC and the Portal BASE as the source and link each contract's page.
provenance.how: IMPIC's yearly file on dados.gov.pt (contratos2026.zip), stream-parsed in memory, the approach of PrompTugal__News__Civic tools/extract-base.mjs

about: Public contracts published on the Portal BASE in the last 90 days (from 2026-08-29) where the contracting entity is the câmara municipal of Lisboa or of one of the Algarve's 16 municipalities (Quarteira is a parish of Loulé and has no câmara of its own). From IMPIC's open data, which is updated about weekly: a contract appears here some days after it is signed. object is cut to 200 characters. A contractor that is a company keeps its name and NIF; a contractor that looks like a natural person (its NIF, or none) is shown only as "a natural person", and the contract's object text is then left out. Our record, not an official one: each contract links its page on base.gov.pt.
note: The dataset file had not changed since the last read, so it was not downloaded again; each contract keeps the time of the read that found it.
